name: Claude Code instructions note
description: Adds the 'Tracking work (o-lane)' note to Claude Code's user instructions, between o-lane markers; the rest of the file is untouched.
content:
## Tracking work (o-lane)

Track the work you do for the owner as lanes, not as mtm tasks: mtm tasks are the owner's, and you create or edit them only when the owner asks. Every lane read and write (define, add, status, associate, annotate, reword, link, list, and the docs that hold findings) goes through mtm: the mtm MCP gateway (`run` with `lane.lane define`, `lane.lane add`, `lane.lane set` (the `status` prop), `lane.lane associate`, `lane.lane annotate`, `lane.lane list`, `lane.plan define`, and `md.doc new` for docs), or, without MCP, the mtm CLI (`mtm lane set ID status=done reason="..."`, `mtm lane plan define ...`, `mtm md doc new ...`). Do not call the `o-lane` binary or another MCP server directly.

Every lane belongs to a project: use the matching mtm project (`mtm project list`), and if none fits, create one (`mtm project new NAME --dir DIR`) rather than leaving lanes unscoped. Make one root lane per owner request, with the owner's words as its wording (`mtm lane define --project PROJECT --lanes '[...]'`, or `mtm lane plan define` from a plan's Lanes table), and a child lane per piece of work. Set each lane's status as it moves (planned, running, review, merged, done, parked, cancelled) with `mtm lane set ID status=VALUE reason="..."` (the lane `status` prop and its reason in one call), and associate a lane with the pane that runs it (`mtm lane associate --pane WINDOW_ID`) so the owner's Lanes page shows live status. Write findings and reports as a Markdown doc linked to the lane; use notes only for short jots.

Keep lane statuses true; the main (coordinating) agent owns this for every lane it started or delegated:
- Create the root and child lanes when the work starts, not afterwards, and set `running` and associate the pane in the same step.
- `running` means an agent is working on it right now in an associated pane. When that stops, change the status before ending your turn: `review` (work exists but is not merged: name the branch), `merged`, `done`, `parked` (paused or waiting: say on what) or `cancelled`. Give the reason in the same call, `mtm lane set ID status=review reason="branch X"` (or `--note` on `park`, `finish`, `cancel`); it shows as the lane's reason on the Lanes page.
- A pane belongs to one lane: associate it with the lane it now works on, and mtm moves it off the old one.
- At session start, before a handoff, and when the owner asks, reconcile: every `running` lane (`mtm lane list --status running`) must have an associated pane whose agent is working (`tuios list-windows -s SESSION --json`: `agent_state`); fix any that don't, with a note saying what was found. Update the parent when all its children have moved.
